notes.title: [Devlog] Introducing New Feature: Ascendancy Sub-Classes
notes.content:
[p]​Long time ago we have started working on how to make the progression system more interesting and engaging. Today we bring brand new system called Ascendancy Sub-Classes. Before, players were not getting any bonuses, special perks and etc depending on legendary weapons and abilities they use. But now things are changed a lot! [/p][p]P.S: New update will be available in Early Access release. However if you want to try it out before everyone else, you can play [b][url="https://ent-re-games.itch.io/bug-alliance"]Exclusive build[/url][/b] here on our [b][url="https://ent-re-games.itch.io/bug-alliance"]Itch.io[/url] page.[/b][/p][p]​​[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/687dd8a501a00a330fc2974d91c1e30e031b4f16.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Each character has 4 unique ascendancy sub-classes, which players can unlock by combining a legendary weapon with a legendary ability. To do so, player must have a character ascended to the legendary rank. Here are ascendancy sub-classes and their perks for each bug character:[/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]PRUVER:[/b][/p][p]​[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/d498bcda22be5896a574990225cba8eb95a0805d.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Combat Engineer[/b]
[i]Legendary Vengeance  + Legendary RT-V1 MG Turret[/i][/p][list][*][p]Attaches a mini turret to Pruver’s shoulder that intercepts incoming projectiles. Has 3 charges and recharges every 5 seconds. Kills with Vengeance reduce recharge by 0.2 sec[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Combat Medic[/b]
[i]Legendary Vengeance​ + Legendary Mandibula Drone[/i][/p][list][*][p]Drone creates a large safezone that restores allies’ health and gives +20% damage reduction. Active the safezone by pressing MMB.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Fireline Engineer[/b]
[i]Legendary Fury & Wrath + Legendary RT-V1 MG Turret​[/i][/p][list][*][p]Turrets deal 70% splash damage to enemies near the primary target. Turrets get +50 max ammo .[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Medic Operative[/b]
[i]Legendary Fury & Wrath + Legendary Mandibula Drone​[/i][/p][list][*][p]Every 10 seconds, Drone drops random supplies (Medkit, Ammo or Shield Plate). Kills with Fury & Wrath reduce supply drop cooldown by 0.2 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]OCTAVIUS:[/b][/p][p]​​[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/8ce583a6495adb6157e6fc73e009fd907961514a.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Burrowed Slayer[/b]
[i]Legendary Hazor + Legendary Bristle Barrier​[/i][/p][list][*][p]Bristle Barrier no longer has a duration and becomes highly durable. Two barriers can be active at the same time. If both are deployed, Octavius can travel between them by pressing [b]MMB[/b] (3-second cooldown).[/p][/*][/list][p]​[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Silken Spearmaw[/b]
[i]Legendary Hazor + Legendary Mordant Web[/i][/p][list][*][p]Killing enemies entangled in webs grants +0.025 permanent Max Health. If killed with Hazor, gain +0.05 Max Health instead. Stacks infinitely.[/p][/*][/list][p]​[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]​[b]Defiant Butcher[/b]
[i]Legendary Chopy + Legendary Bristle Barrier[/i][/p][list][*][p]Enemies killed have a 30% chance to drop Trophies. Collecting 30 Trophies enters [b]Hunt Down[/b] state, greatly boosting weapon damage, fire rate and movement speed. Trophy drop chance is 100% when killing enemies with Chopy.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]​[b]Spineweb Cleaver[/b]
[i]Legendary Chopy + Legendary Mordant Web[/i][/p][list][*][p]Webs apply Bleeding damage to entangled enemies. Killing a bleeding enemy with Chopy spreads bleeding to 3 nearby enemies.[/p][/*][/list][p]​[/p][/*][/list][p][b]KAZI:[/b][/p][p]​[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/f1e4c6b8c6c4dd93ccaf94a4aa04a55254315d49.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]​[b]Plague Alchemist[/b]
[i]Legendary Fuminator + Legendary Toxister[/i][/p][list][*][p]Pressing [b]MMB[/b] summons a durable Slime Minion that follows Kazi. The Slime releases AOE gas damaging nearby enemies. Also it taunts nearby enemies. On death it explodes, dealing venom damage and applying venom status. Heals while standing on Toxister’s venom pool.[/p][/*][/list][p]​[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Noxborn Cloudstriker[/b]
[i]Legendary Fuminator + Legendary Noxious Flee[/i][/p][list][*][p]Kills with Fuminator fill a bar (5% per kill). Each bar percentage increases Noxious Flee’s range and damage. Using Noxious Flee at max bar causes the toxic cloud to make enemies berserk, forcing them to attack each other for 3 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p]​[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]​[b]Hazard Bomber[/b]
[i]Legendary Noxinator + Legendary Toxister[/i][/p][list][*][p]Summons a toxic Gelato substance with a 30-second duration.  Shooting Gelato with Noxinator causes it to absorb the shot and fire a long range, poisonous high-AOE mortar at enemies. Summoning Gelato on Toxister’s pool transforms it into Venomous Gelato.[/p][/*][/list][p]​[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]​[b]Blighted Surge[/b]
[i]Legendary Noxinator + Legendary Noxious Flee[/i][/p][list][*][p]Killing enemies with Noxinator during Noxious Flee fills the bar (+10% per kill). At max bar, pressing [b]MMB[/b] consumes the bar, boosting Kazi’s weapon damage, fire rate and reload speed, while adding 30% Poison chance to attacks for 10 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p]​[/p][/*][/list][p][b]​BROGAR:[/b][/p][p]​[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/bea30ebd3cce0802d3213a77b4770a64065e076d.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Razorstorm Titan[/b]
[i]Legendary Hailstorm + Legendary Impaling Surge[/i][/p][list][*][p]Each damage taken increases Brogar’s Temper level. Each Temper level grows 2 spikes on Brogar that reflect damage back to melee attackers. At max Temper, Brogar can release spikes in a piercing volley ([b]MMB[/b]), each dealing 10 damage. While at max temper level, Hailstorm bullets gain 20% Bleed chance.[/p][/*][/list][p]​[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]​[b]Bulletbane Reaper[/b]
[i]Legendary Hailstorm + Legendary Gore Shred[/i][/p][list][*][p]Each enemy hit by Gore Shred grants +5% armor penetration to Hailstorm bullets for 10 seconds (stacks up to 5). At max stacks, Hailstorm bullets ricochet to 3 nearby enemies.[/p][/*][/list][p]​[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]​[b]Sundermaul Crusher[/b]
[i]Legendary Blastspike + Legendary Impaling Surge[/i][/p][list][*][p]If Impaling Surge hits at least 5 enemies, Brogar gains 1 Crusher Charge (max 2). Pressing [b]MMB[/b] consumes a charge, releasing a shockwave in front of Brogar (cone area) that reduces enemy armor by 70% and speed by 50% for 10 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p]​[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]​[b]Shattermaw Brute[/b]
[i]Legendary Blastspike + Legendary Gore Shred[/i][/p][list][*][p]Killing enemies marked by Gore Shred with Blastspike causes them to explode, dealing 5 AOE damage. Enemies killed by the explosion will also explode. Enemies survived, will be marked.[/p][/*][/list][p]​[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: [Devlog] Introducing New Feature - Tactical Gears
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/22ebbb7be094880446367d9af2e9f439e2448898.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Tactical Gears are coming to Bug Alliance![/h3][p]Unlock powerful tools like grenades, elemental ammo, airstrikes & more — earn them through kills and dominate the battlefields. You can unlock new tactical gears while evolving your character. Each gear is unlocked at certain Evo stage. This feature will be available in [b]Early Access release[/b]. However, currently it is also available in [b]Exclusive Build[/b] on [b][url="https://ent-re-games.itch.io/bug-alliance" buttoncolor="#ff2954"]Itch.io[/url].[/b][/p][p]Think fast. Strike harder. Evolve smarter.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/f188e3fc6da9c08d62707d8b6fb267136652e3cb.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There are 15 tactical gears are available currently:[/p][list][*][p]Frag Grenade - deals explosive damage and bleeds enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Magnetic Pull - pulls essence, ammo, health and other collectibles towards player.[/p][/*][*][p]Echo Pulse - releases a shockwave that knockbacks enemies away from player in a radius.[/p][/*][*][p]Napalm Canister - deals fire damage in an area and burns enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Shock Cell - deals lightning damage in an area and shocks enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Cryo Core - deals frost damage in an area and freezes enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Firefly Bombardment - aerial bombardment that deals high explosive damage in a large area.[/p][/*][*][p]Overdrive - resets cooldown of abilities and gives +1 charge.[/p][/*][*][p]Barries Flux - gives high amount of elemental resistance.[/p][/*][*][p]Shield Pack - gives +2 shield plates.[/p][/*][*][p]Razor Rounds- special ammo with a high chance of bleeding enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Frostbite Rounds- special ammo with a high chance of freezing enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Volt Rounds - special ammo with a high chance of shocking enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Rotten Rounds - special ammo with a high chance of poisoning enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Scorch Rounds - special ammo with a high chance of burning enemies[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/8f80edf4ddc94df75e5a661a604907e60b097d53.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: MAJOR DEMO UPDATE 3.0 IS LIVE!
notes.content:
[h2]NEW FEATURES, REWORKS, IMPROVEMENTS, MUSIC AND MORE AWAIT YOU![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/8c72241bcc154e9d2cd9803a0306625ffd5cdf55.png[/img]


[b][u][h3]NEW CHARACTER REDESIGNS AND REWORKS[/h3][/u][/b]
Our bug warriors just got a makeover! Each character has been visually redesigned with more detail, personality, and flair—bringing their unique playstyles to life like never before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/1ec4e5bd0cf8fe18ad8c250f249fb5f79c7a4824.gif[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b][u][h3]REVAMPED GAME MODES[/h3][/u][/b]
We've overhauled our core game modes for tighter pacing and more thrilling challenges.
[b]Onslaught mode[/b] brings you unforgettable survival experience with progressive difficulty increment and smarter enemy waves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/475f870859abe4a80c12446c174669d4a30e40eb.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/ad5cb046ca6a170f3c1c16b92c19a19f57107c03.gif[/img]

[b]Resistance mode[/b] now makes you feel a real taste of tower defense mechanics, where you only rely on strategy and tactics. Whether you're diving into Survival or Resistance expect refined mechanics and an adrenaline-pumping experience from start to finish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/4ba88b395ef2700b2887f046ca32d1838c240165.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/239d0ce153c1e3b5042942bc25256b680adc71f5.gif[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b][u][h3]REVAMPED EVOLUTION AND PROGRESSION SYSTEM[/h3][/u][/b]
Your path to bug supremacy just got deeper. The improved progression system allows you to evolve and ascend more than one character with available one ascended weapon and ability for each. Additionally, improved growing stat boosts and fresh visuals making every tier-up a meaningful leap forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/1b9b8657fafb8d64a1ae6e99dc0d68f60d3cd0e4.gif[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b][u][h3]REWORKED UPGRADE CARD SYSTEM[/h3][/u][/b]
The upgrade card system has been fully redesigned for more impactful choices and strategic depth. Now you are able to choose [b]Random [/b]or [b]Free Choice[/b] upgrade system. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/6a524692bc95da26ca5172660a264dcf34f99443.gif[/img]

[b]Random system[/b] will give you 3 random upgrade cards every level up, which makes each game randomized and unique. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/6c019a0fb511ffb1639961b0449cc1689750e638.gif[/img]

[b]Free Choice[/b] system gives you an opportunity to choose upgrade cards freely among three categories and create your own build.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/e5e8b4e924ad822a4e41dd544add931133588ec0.gif[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b][u][h3]NEW STATUS CHANCE AND ELEMENTAL DAMAGE SYSTEM[/h3][/u][/b]
Combat now crackles with elemental power! Inflict poison, lightning, bleed, and more with our new status and elemental systems—adding depth, synergy, and chaos to every character, weapon and ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/49827d0c6204398f505b6b0b1f675e42a774c46b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/a716d899ee139279e361a0b91f8635b0d09d12f4.gif[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b][u][h3]CONTROLLER SUPPORT[/h3][/u][/b]
Plug in and play your way. Full controller support is here, offering smooth controls, optimized navigation, and a seamless gameplay experience whether you're on keyboard or gamepad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/0659d686bfb2744f1e3792e48c39d180eae4ff77.png[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b][u][h3]REWORKED TUTORIAL SYSTEM[/h3][/u][/b]
New to Bug Alliance? Our redesigned tutorial makes it easier than ever to learn the ropes. With clear guidance and dynamic teaching moments, you’ll be battle-ready in no time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/d13a0885b286037635ac4a013f6eaa0e676e8fef.gif[/img]

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE 2.1
notes.content:
[b][h2]LOOT CHESTS AND BARREL LOOTS[/h2][/b]
Enemies can drop loot chest which contain some amount of essence. Later on we plan to add random upgrade cards and power-up loots into the chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/e9b131a04bac003f3847cce3c33a2ff27ad3e520.gif[/img]

Barrels may contain some loots as well, such as ammo, medkit, essence and etc. So do not hesitate to break them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/b344bbccbc9327cd948bb16ab17f6c87ecdf09f9.gif[/img]


[b][h2]LEVEL UP EFFECT[/h2][/b]
An effect for character in game level up has been added. This will make the level up system more interesting and increase the engagement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/4b838d152649ba41c640b50331afe9b14a57c8f6.gif[/img]


[b][h2]DEATH ANIMATION AND EFFECT[/h2][/b]
According to feedback, an animation and effect for character death is added. Now it is not directly shows the result screen, which increases the game experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/32b8b41e25d0d88f547294b033e6cecc5d3fdc61.gif[/img]


[b][h2]BUG FIXES[/h2][/b]

notes.title: NEW DEMO UPDATE 2.0 IS AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=7oHf7jo3JRk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Main Menu and Game Setup System[/h2]
New main menu is here—sleeker, faster, and more intuitive than ever! In addition, new game setup system makes you choose settings you wish, select your character and jump into the action with ease.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/432a00b49a0681c80a04cb117a6e51c9311fee9f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/93e1c7173e34646ed34cc28884000c5cae1823fd.jpg[/img]

[h2]Completely New Revamped UI[/h2]
Introducing better, eye catching and easy to use HUD. More minimalistic view makes it easier to check stats, while not being distracted from the game. No more complex system!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/ff7bfb033be8c6a47af413b4e1b2822120f19d39.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/d1c65cf956c4de2b6ccc43206e19ab9fc0ed550d.png[/img]

[h2]Auto-Aim System[/h2]
Due to the high amount of feedback, we finally brought auto-aim feature to the game. Players now can use it to easily aim and enjoy the rest. Auto-aim can be toggled on / off, so feel free to use it as you wish. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/be837f623052da4f3174070135465b18bdb4db0d.gif[/img]

[h2]NEW ENEMIES[/h2]
[h3]Elemental Enraged[/h3]
Infused with various elemental powers, enraged enemies are the true danger. Beware of getting too close to them or you will taste some random elemental strike. Actually you can try at your own risk, if you are brave enough.  They appear at Wave 6 and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/ffa7583004a1e401388510b03ee3891d484a9da9.gif[/img]

[h3]Mortids[/h3]
They are artillery power of king Glutton and excel at long range attacks. Prioritizing on them will save your life, as it will be almost impossible to stand, if they swarm you on the battleground. They appear at Wave 13 and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/376381b461dfdcaea13a34a8d67bf5d6d6e9e26f.gif[/img]

[h2]NEW ABILITY COOLDOWN SYSTEM[/h2]
Killing enemies will now reduce ability cooldown by 1 sec, giving players an opportunity to use their abilities more often. This will greatly enhance the gaming experience adding more action and engagement to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/16efee797eec7dd48e75f2374b6668b340232a25.gif[/img]

notes.title: THE DAYS OF RAMADAN - NEW DEMO SHOWCASE
DEVLOG Part 1 - Challenges & Achievements
notes.content:
We have finally finished working on Challenges and Achievement system. Currently there are 74+ challenges in the game, as well as Steam achievements. By completing these challenges players will be able to unlock new bug characters, maps, rewards and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/78ed50cf54e5066b0743beac128bb812b9c22a28.gif[/img]

This feature will be available with full game release in early 2025. In addition we aim to add even more engaging and hardcore challenges. Stay tuned for more Devlog updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/bb93b2c1e166d4e6b109e6928af850f982d969a4.gif[/img]

notes.title: BUG ALLIANCE - NEW DEMO UPDATE SHOWCASE
BUG ALLIANCE - Steam Next Fest Broadcast
THE WARFRONT UPDATE NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=RBM0LGP6ESk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]NEW GAME MODE - RESISTANCE[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/cb2d0f01d8a53cb16d6a419245f2b8b8d9c0dc02.png[/img]

In this mode players will have to defend the mining station, while it gathers valuable resources. For that players should build towers on fructure points or platforms using Freotine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/255b01ab535f2e960f6e3c1c5c33fe99e3850b79.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/cbb7425c483ee6c7658c86c787c836fd61d5e35b.gif[/img]

Players also can upgrade towers and mining station with Freotine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/fa2125be71d3e401099306a1344aed8fe6a7b82c.png[/img]  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/b597771725d90c9560023398379a7b4db8165717.png[/img]

Each mining stage lasts 5 minutes, after which players choose whether to continue mining for another 5 minutes or take farmed resources and evacuate. And chance of rare resources and game difficulty increases each round. How deep will you be able to mine?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/f911756c57daad687a2dd6219315cb596944788f.gif[/img]


[h3][b]NEW BUG CHARACTER - BROGAR[/b][/h3] (Available in exclusive patreon build)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/b99eaa62e419879baa86c7403704d7beef4534b1.png[/img]

Brogar is a juggernaut berserker with immense power and thirst to kill. He is literally an unstoppable killing machine.

[b]PASSIVE SKILL
[/b]
Berserker's Fury:
Every 25% HP loss increases fire rate and weapon damage by 10%.
If HP loss reaches 75%, Brogar gains lifesteal ( 5% of damage done) for 3 seconds. This can occur every 30 seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/b61e1222728764c46990fc46bae61c6fff2743a2.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/12921f2c1acbfda565767736f436dea841f1f1ad.gif[/img]

[b]WEAPONS:[/b]

[b]"Hailstorm" LMG[/b] - A deadly light machine gun with extremely high magazine capacity and a good fire rate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/5aa1728e440c3effef9dcf2248170373ed0907d7.gif[/img]

[b]"Blastspike" Shotgun[/b] - A double barrel shotgun capable of mass destruction at close range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/e31a1f0b528d3e5431f3cd21e5bced4331c8b113.gif[/img]

[b]ABILITIES:[/b]

[b]Gore Shred[/b] - Brogar attacks and cuts enemies with his jaw-like mandibulas, that marks enemies and makes them take increased damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/91936a92f6afb17b8798bf96741c2b3159357f44.gif[/img]

[b]Impaling Surge[/b] - Brogar sends down a wave of tremors that impales and damages enemies, while healing himself for the portion of damage dealt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/0a540c58aaa919e41e8942c86536acf1230a58f7.gif[/img]


[h3][b]NEW ENEMIES[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/66105d3e316530f9c103b36e305e6ff65de37fb0.png[/img]

[b]VULPER[/b]
Vulpers are agile and extremely dangerous flying worms. They are fast enough to catch you up in a blink of an eye. Their tail is like a hand making it easy to grab their prey and call others for a nasty feast. Some say, Blood Forest is their natural nest, so be careful roaming out there. You dont want to be eaten alive by one of those, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/e60a2e1e3a836689e6310e111284589887009af8.png[/img]

[b]BLISTERS[/b]
Blisters are literally kamikaze worms. They jump on a target and suicide by exploding themselves. There could be little damage when only one explodes, but they usually attack in groups. So that means hell of a mess out there when five of them explodes at once. Do not even try to get close to them...or you may try it at your own risk!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/b58d160528bf4ecad52f925b0e833861bde545af.png[/img]

[b]CRUSHING OPPRESSOR BOSS[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/30e53ad565f122c50f9eb8e08de2c8b2c09a9879.png[/img]
Crushing Oppressor is the new boss that can be encountered in both Survival and Resistance game modes. He is extremely dangerous and durable. Oppressor is capable of bringing hails of rock on anyone that trespasses his territory. If you get close enough, get ready to taste the wave of deadly stone spikes. Are you brave enough to face him? Let the hunt begin!


[h3][b]DAY AND NIGHT CYCLE[/b][/h3]
Day and night cycle has been added to the game. Day lasts 5 minutes, whereas night lasts 3 minutes. This improves the game experience and gives a fantastic atmosphere to the game. Beware of vulpers at night, they are pretty sneaky hunters. Don't forget to use your flashlight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046144/02725e29940779b489f6fdfb853f9f2206f626ca.png[/img]

- Added Passive Skill:
When Pruver is near his turret & drone;
Turret fire rate increases by 10% and damage by 15%.
Drone will heal Pruver by 3HP, if his health drops to 1. This can only occur  once per drone.

- Added Passive Skill:
Enemies under 50% HP will be marked and receive 30% more damage
Octavius senses incoming projectiles and finds their trajectories, which makes it easy to escape or dodge. Direction of incoming projectiles is marked.

Dealing damage with a weapon or an ability fuses a chemical in a target. Combining two different fusions will start a reaction. This can occur every 10 seconds.
 
Acid fuse + Toxic fuse = Corrosive Leak

Gas fuse + Acid fuse = Acidic Ignition

Toxic fuse + Gas fuse = Infectious Gas
